zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Noxious caverns covered in mushrooms; caustic acid pools; home of Mushroom Clan and Mantis Tribe

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.fingerprintHint: Home of the Mantis Tribe; location of Mantis Lords boss; contains Mark of Pride chest and Mantis Claw
zones.note: Located in the south part of Fungal Wastes

zones.name: Queen's Station
zones.fingerprintHint: Large Stag Station in the west part of Fungal Wastes; hub connecting Fog Canyon and Fungal Wastes to Stagways

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.note: Connected to Fungal Wastes via Pilgrim's Way

zones.name: City of Tears

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.note: Accessible via entrance in Mantis Village after defeating Mantis Lords; shares border with Fungal Wastes/Mushroom Clan territory

zones.name: Fog Canyon
zones.note: Connected to Fungal Wastes via Queen's Station

zones.name: Dirtmouth
